scope: Entire original server function43 reconstructed as high-level JavaScript against the original shared-memory ABI. This module replaces one real function body; it does not delegate to original function43.

limitations: Dependencies listed below remain explicit runtime calls and may still execute original machine code until their owning modules replace them.
Differential validation is bounded evidence, not a proof over every input, malformed pointer alias, corrupt intrusive list, allocator exhaustion or indirect callback.
The labels health, loadout, pickup and attacker are inferred from instruction dataflow and catalog use; unresolved component fields retain numeric offsets.
No claim is made that this single module completes the full client/server reconstruction.
